text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп's victory is hotly anticipated
as the
autumn Tenno Sho is about to
begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Intent on defeating her, Супер Крик
finishes
practicing for her role as the
villain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She heads over to the racecourse to stir
up the
crowd at the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
